description: This file defines several Orleans grain interfaces related to exception handling and message serialization, along with associated types, codecs, and utility classes. It includes interfaces for grains that throw exceptions and handle serialization/deserialization of custom types, as well as serializers for those types.

classes.name: UndeserializableType
classes.description: A struct representing a type that cannot be deserialized, contains a constant message and a single integer property 'Number'.

classes.name: UnserializableType
classes.description: An empty class representing a type that is not serializable.

classes.name: UndeserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and copier for 'UndeserializableType', throws exceptions when attempting to read or write.

classes.name: UnserializableTypeCodec
classes.description: A serializer and copier for 'UnserializableType', throws exceptions when attempting to write, returns default when reading.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input 'UndeserializableType' or 'UnserializableType'.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of 'UndeserializableType' from a reader; throws NotSupportedException.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes the 'Number' field of 'UndeserializableType' or throws NotSupportedException for 'UnserializableType'.
